meta.name: animation-vocabulary
meta.description: Reverse-lookup glossary that turns a vague description of a web animation or motion effect into its exact term ("the bouncy thing when a popover opens" → Pop in; "the iOS rubber-band scroll" → Rubber-banding). Use when the user asks "what's it called when…", or describes a motion effect without knowing its name and wants the right word to prompt an AI or designer with. For naming an effect, not designing or building one.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 说出网页动效的准确叫法,描述不再含糊
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果能看到某个网页动效、却叫不出名字,想让沟通更准确
copy.tagline_en: Put an exact name to a web animation you can only describe vaguely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you notice a web motion effect but can't name it to your team or an AI.

howto.what: 你把看到的动效凭感觉描述出来,它会反查出准确术语,按「术语 — 原文解释」的格式给出;若有多个术语都沾边,先给最贴切的,再列 1~2 个并说明区别。它只负责命名,不做设计或实现。
howto.when: 当你说「这叫什么来着……」,或描述某个动效却不知道名字、想要一个准确的词去跟 AI 或设计师沟通时接管。

say.text: 弹出层从被点的那个按钮长出来,这叫什么?
say.note: 返回 Origin-aware animation 及其解释

say.text: iOS 里滚动拉过头会顶住再回弹,那个叫什么?
一张图变成另一张图叫什么?相近的也说下。
say.note: 返回 Morph,并对比 Crossfade 等

howto.what_en: It turns a vague description of a motion or effect into its exact term, returned as the term plus a one-line definition; when several fit, it lists the closest first, then 1–2 alternates noting the difference. Naming only, not building.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask "what's it called when…", or describe a motion effect without knowing its name and want the right word to prompt an AI or designer.

say_en.text: What's it called when a popover grows out of the button you clicked?
What's the iOS scroll that resists and snaps back called?
One image turning into another — what's that called?
